decisions.decision: How feasible is it to use Tree-Ring Watermarking for Rectified Flow Models (FLUX).
decisions.answer: Technically feasible but currently weak for real-world use: detection works reasonably on clean FLUX.1-dev images with exact prompts, but robustness and separability collapse under common attacks and when prompts are missing or approximated, making production deployment premature without improved inversion and more robust watermarking.
decisions.notes: Clean, prompt-known scenarios show acceptable reconstruction and bit error for FLUX.1-dev, but attacks (blur, noise, Waves-style) and prompt uncertainty drastically reduce separability and reliability.
